title: TAI public-schema PUBLIC ACL hardening
objective: Remove only explicit PUBLIC relation and column ACL entries from non-TAI relations in the public PostgreSQL schema so the dedicated tai_runtime principal cannot inherit cross-domain table access and the exact-main standalone TAI deployment can pass its effective-access boundary.
boundaries: Only explicit ACL entries whose grantee is PostgreSQL PUBLIC are removed
Only relations and columns in schema public whose names do not start with tai_ are in scope
Object ownership, tenant data, rows, policies, functions, schemas, application-role ACLs and TAI relation ACLs are unchanged
No DROP OWNED, REASSIGN OWNED, object deletion, role creation, role deletion or broad schema mutation
The migration is forward-only, transactional, idempotent and fails closed if any scoped PUBLIC ACL remains
The existing application roles must continue to use explicit least-privilege grants; exact-main full-stack and durable-intake acceptance remain mandatory after merge
